## Summary

What changed, and why.

## Docs

- [ ] The behaviour change is reflected in `docs/`, or there is no behaviour change.
- [ ] A new page is listed in `mkdocs.yml`.
- [ ] A new direction is a new ADR, not an edit that changes the meaning of an old one.

## Checks

CI covers ruff, mypy, import-linter, pytest, the frontend, and `mkdocs build --strict`.
